instance_description:
Setting: A 2026 household consumer-finance workspace for an owner-occupied townhome in Cary, North Carolina, centered on family expenses and everyday purchasing.
Scope: Recurring activities include mortgage and HOA tracking, utilities, school and activity fees, auto upkeep, insurance paperwork, subscriptions, appliance service, returns, warranties, and receipt organization.
Resources: Later Scenarios may populate empty SQLite tables, text workpads, and the Wallet with neutral facts, draft checklists, vendor notes, payment planning details, and consumer case records.
Exclusions: No business bookkeeping, investment trading, tax filing advice, legal strategy, credit applications, debt settlement, or irreversible high-stakes financial commitments.
personal_description:
Identity: Gideon Mateo Ravel is a 42-year-old middle-school band teacher and single father of two who owns a modest townhome and manages his household’s consumer records.
Responsibilities: He plans routine family spending, keeps bill and service documentation, tracks children’s fees, compares household vendors, and preserves receipts for repairs and claims.
Authority: Gideon can organize records, draft merchant or insurer messages, prepare payment checklists, categorize expenses, and document consumer follow-ups for his own household.
Restrictions: He cannot manage school funds, make professional financial recommendations, trade securities, bypass account security, or authorize actual payments unless a Scenario explicitly instructs it.
